description:
Premier League Team of the Season - Premier League Topps NOW® 12 -Card Set

Celebrate the 2025/26 Premier League Team of the Season with this incredible 12-card set featuring the very best players from this campaign. The set includes stars such as Bruno Fernandes, Erling Haaland, Declan Rice and William Saliba, with parallels & special autographs of selected players available in lucky orders.

11 Base Cards (Fixed) PLUS 1 Guaranteed 'hit' (parallel, unnumbered parallel or autograph) per set.

The 2025/26 Premier League Team of the Season includes:

David Raya (Arsenal)

Gabriel Magalhães (Arsenal)

William Saliba (Arsenal)

Jurriën Timber (Arsenal)

Nico O’Reilly (Manchester City)

Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool FC)

Declan Rice (Arsenal)

Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United)

Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City)

Erling Haaland (Manchester City)

Igor Thiago (Brentford)

All sales are final. Print runs revealed after sales window expires. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors. In an effort to mitigate our carbon footprint, shipments may be grouped together within the same order. Large orders may be consolidated into bulk packaging at Topps’ discretion.
